name: fix-backend-ci-install
title: Restore CI dependency installation after staff PR merge
description: Align the backend dependency manifest with its existing lockfile so frontend and backend CI jobs can reach their test steps.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Both CI jobs previously stopped at backend npm ci because package.json declared mongoose-lean-virtuals ^0.8.0 while package-lock.json records ^2.0.0. PR #1274 aligns the stale manifest entry. CI now passes both backend install steps and lint. A temporary targeted run proved staff-create-business-context.test.js and AddEmployeeModal.test.jsx both pass, then the diagnostic workflow was removed. The full backend suite still reports a separate failure outside those two focused tests; frontend unit execution remains outside this task's one-line dependency fix.
